name: Paramon and Philomenus
venerable Acacius, the testimony of whom is found in “The Ladder of Divine Ascent”
kontakia: (Tone 4) You washed your soul clean of all impurity* by following the divine mandates.* This is how you endured your martyrdom.* You refused to offer sacrifice to any idol;* therefore, they pierced you with a spear.* This is how you followed Christ.* O blessed Paramon,* pray for all of us.
